links.outcome: LLM errors in emergency triage across simulated cases, rated by emergency physicians
links.effect: Triage was the most error-prone domain across all four models; re-prompting after misleading outputs significantly improved applicability for ChatGPT-o3mini, Gemini 2.0-Pro, and DeepSeek-R1, particularly in triage.
links.quote: Triage emerged as the most error-prone domain across all models.

unlisted_practices: Re-prompting LLMs after misleading or inappropriate outputs to elicit self-correction

screen.reason: The study evaluates multiple LLMs on emergency simulation cases with expert clinician evaluation and tests a specific interaction safeguard/practice: re-prompting misleading/inappropriate outputs to measure self-correction capabilities.
